# Epic #319 synthetic walkthrough fixtures

These files contain fictional placeholder content for the contributor and
maintainer walkthrough in [`docs/community/epic-319-walkthrough.md`](../../../docs/community/epic-319-walkthrough.md).
They are test examples, not approved production content. GitHub issues and
attachments are public; submit them only after explicit owner authorization.
Never replace them with real or unsanitized project files.

The DOCX, XLSX, legacy XLS, and mixed ZIP contain synthetic examples only.
The `.fixture` file is intentionally not a supported office format. No file
has been uploaded to GitHub issues or published in the production catalog.
